plainText:
Masaki Aizawa (相沢まさき Aizawa Masaki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Aizawa was born on January 19, 1965 in , . He began to provide voices for near the end of , where his first role was Professor Telesu. His most prominent roles are two villainous team leaders: Archie, the leader of Team Aqua from ; and Ghetsis, the leader of Team Plasma from . Later, in , he played one of the four island kahunas, Nanu. Aizawa is currently affiliated with OFFICE OSAWA.
